source: Modelled from Google's published reference 'MCP Reference: calendarmcp.googleapis.com' (developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/mcp, one page per tool under tools_list/), read through Context7 (/websites/developers_google_workspace_calendar_api) on 2026-10-27. Not a capture: the endpoint answers 401 without a token. Nested object schemas (attendee, reminder, attachment, guest permissions) are reduced to the fields the reference names; capture tools/list with a signed-in account to replace this file.

tools.name: list_calendars
tools.description: Lists the calendars on the user's calendar list.

pageSize.description: Optional. Max results per page. Default `100`, max `250`.

pageToken.description: Optional. Token specifying which result page to return.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Lists events on the given calendar, optionally in a time range and matching a free-text query.

eventType.description: The event types to return. If empty, only the following event types are returned: DEFAULT, OUT_OF_OFFICE, FOCUS_TIME, FROM_GMAIL

calendarId.description: ID of the calendar. Email address - can be resolved using `list_calendars`. Default: primary calendar.

pageSize.description: Max events per page (default `100`, max `250`). Recommended: `10`.

pageToken.description: Next page token. Use the value from the previous page's `nextPageToken`.

startTime.description: The lower bound of a time range. Must be an ISO 8601 timestamp less than `end_time`.

endTime.description: The upper bound of a time range. Must be an ISO 8601 timestamp greater than `start_time`.

timeZone.description: Time zone (IANA ID, for example `Europe/Zurich`) used to resolve timezone-less dates. Default: calendar's timezone.

orderBy.description: The order in which events should be returned.

fullText.description: Free-form case-insensitive search matching title, description, location, or attendees. Matches events containing all query terms verbatim (AND search).

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Searches events on the user's primary calendar using semantic search.

query.description: Required. Query string to search for events (case-insensitive).

pageSize.description: Optional. Maximum number of entries returned on one result page.

pageToken.description: Optional. Token specifying which result page to return.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Gets one event of the given calendar.

calendarId.description: ID of the calendar. Email address - can be resolved using `list_calendars`. Default: primary calendar.

tools.name: suggest_time
tools.description: Suggests free time slots for the given attendees within a time interval.

attendeeEmails.description: Required. Attendee emails to find free time for.

timeZone.description: Optional. Time zone for search times (IANA ID, for example `Europe/Zurich`).

durationMinutes.description: Optional. Min duration of free slot in minutes. Default: `30`.

pageSize.description: Max number of slots to return. Default: `5`.

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Creates an event on the given calendar.

optional.description: Whether this is an optional attendee.

attendees.description: Optional. Attendees of the event. For events created on the user's primary calendar with at least one other attendee, the current user is automatically added if not already included.

recurrenceData.description: Optional. Recurrence rules as RRULE, RDATE, or EXDATE strings (per RFC 5545).

method.description: The method used by this reminder: email or popup.

minutes.description: Number of minutes before the start of the event when the reminder should trigger.

overrideReminders.description: Optional. Reminders that override calendar defaults.

fileUrl.description: Required. URL link to the attachment.

calendarId.description: Optional. ID of the calendar to create the event on. Email address can be resolved using `list_calendars`. Default: primary calendar.

allDay.description: Optional. Whether the event spans the entire day.

timeZone.description: Optional. IANA Time Zone Database name (e.g., `America/Los_Angeles`). Default: user's primary time zone.

notificationLevel.description: Which email notification should be sent for this event update. NOTIFICATION_LEVEL_UNSPECIFIED is treated as ALL.

addGoogleMeetUrl.description: Optional. Create and add a Google Meet URL. Default: `false`.

visibility.description: Optional. Visibility of the event. Possible values: `default`, `public`, `private`.

colorId.description: Optional. The color of the event.

googleMeetUrl.description: Optional. Specific Google Meet URL or meeting ID. Overrides `add_google_meet_url`.

canInviteOthers.description: Whether attendees other than the organizer can invite others.

canModify.description: Whether attendees other than the organizer can modify the event.

canSeeOtherGuests.description: Whether attendees other than the organizer can see who the event's attendees are.

availability.description: Whether the event blocks time on the calendar.

tools.name: update_event
tools.description: Updates an event on the given calendar.

optional.description: Whether this is an optional attendee.

addedAttendees.description: Optional. Attendees to add to the event.

removedAttendeeEmails.description: Optional. The attendees of the event to remove, as email addresses.

method.description: The method used by this reminder: email or popup.

minutes.description: Number of minutes before the start of the event when the reminder should trigger.

overrideReminders.description: Optional. If set, replaces all existing reminders for the event.

fileUrl.description: Required. URL link to the attachment.

addedAttachments.description: Optional. File attachments to add to the event.

removedAttachmentFileUrls.description: Optional. File attachments to remove from the event.

calendarId.description: ID of the calendar. Email address - can be resolved using `list_calendars`. Default: primary calendar.

description.description: Optional. New description. Can contain HTML.

startTime.description: Optional. New start time (ISO 8601). Preserves duration if updating only start.

allDay.description: Optional. Changes the event to all-day. If set, `start_time`/`end_time` must also be provided.

timeZone.description: Optional. IANA Time Zone Database name. Default: the user's primary time zone.

notificationLevel.description: Which email notification should be sent for this event update. NOTIFICATION_LEVEL_UNSPECIFIED is treated as ALL.

addGoogleMeetUrl.description: Optional. If true, creates or updates a Google Meet URL for the event.

visibility.description: Optional. New visibility of the event. Possible values are: `default`, `public`, `private`.

colorId.description: Optional. New color of the event.

googleMeetUrl.description: Optional. Allows attaching an existing Google Meet URL or meeting ID to the event.

canInviteOthers.description: Whether attendees other than the organizer can invite others.

canModify.description: Whether attendees other than the organizer can modify the event.

canSeeOtherGuests.description: Whether attendees other than the organizer can see who the event's attendees are.

availability.description: Whether the event blocks time on the calendar.

tools.name: delete_event
tools.description: Deletes an event on the given calendar.

eventId.description: Required. The ID of the event to delete.

calendarId.description: ID of the calendar. Email address - can be resolved using `list_calendars`. Default: primary calendar.

notificationLevel.description: Which email notification should be sent for this event update. NOTIFICATION_LEVEL_UNSPECIFIED is treated as ALL.

tools.name: respond_to_event
tools.description: Responds to an event with a response status.

eventId.description: Required. The ID of the event to respond to.

responseStatus.description: Required. The new user's response status of the event.

calendarId.description: ID of the calendar. Email address - can be resolved using `list_calendars`. Default: primary calendar.

notificationLevel.description: Which email notification should be sent for this event update. NOTIFICATION_LEVEL_UNSPECIFIED is treated as ALL.

responseComment.description: Optional. The user's comment attached to the response.
